description: This file contains test specifications for the Playwright test reporter 'dot', including various scenarios such as passing, failing, flaky tests, and configuration-based tests. It uses the Playwright testing framework to verify the correct rendering and behavior of the reporter output.

methods.name: test.describe
methods.description: Defines a suite of related tests, parameterized by whether intermediate merge reports are used.

methods.name: test.use
methods.description: Configures test context settings, such as enabling or disabling features for the tests within the describe block.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines individual test cases, each testing specific aspects of the playwright test reporter 'dot'.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Provides assertion methods to verify test outcomes and output content.
